bio: Currently the Director of Video Production for the Nashville Predators, I have over 15 years leading all 3 phases of video production including 7+ seasons as the Manager of Video Production for the Washington Nationals from 2018-2025. I am dedicated to creating unique ideation spaces, leading others into their strengths, and introducing audiences to new stories through captivating visuals. I'm glad to always have a camera in arm's reach, will listen to any band at least once, and love a good pun.
